title: The role of compliance and of auditors

videos.script: A company can pass every audit and still be breached. Another can be well defended and fail its audit. {{both}} That is because compliance and security answer different questions. Security asks: are we protected? Compliance asks: do we meet the requirements we are bound by, and can we prove it? {{questions}} In this lesson you will meet the requirements the shop is bound by, from a law to a contract with its card processor. {{requirements}} Then the thing auditors actually look at: evidence. Most of it this course has already produced, from the risk register to the restore test. {{evidence}} Last, how an audit runs, and where auditors sit in the organisation so that their word can be trusted. {{lines}}
